title: Chapter 2948 - 175: Mortal Enmity_3
content:
Chapter 2948: Chapter 175: Mortal Enmity_3

From the second year of Divine Blessing, all the way until the fourth year of Divine Blessing.

During these two years, Mo Hua considered for a long time and thought the best course of action was still to kill "Elder You".

Yet he had constantly struggled to find an opportunity to strike.

Although this Elder You was just an elder at the Early Stage of Golden Core, he definitely couldn’t be simply just that.

He was recognized by the Hua family’s ancestor to preside over the arrangements in the Barbaric Wilderness; therefore, his identity couldn’t be ordinary.

Moreover, on the surface, Elder You appeared to be a rather unremarkable, somewhat amiable middle-aged Cultivator.

But this very likely was just his "facade".

It was probably a "disguise" he adopted to negotiate and make deals with various factions, maneuver effortlessly without arousing suspicion.

No one knows what is truly hidden within this middle-aged fat man’s skin.

Not to mention, the Hua family’s ancestor would inevitably "care" for Elder You in terms of Cause and Effect, protecting his life and death.

Even though Mo Hua possesses a near-pure Divinity and cold logic, he is unable to discern Elder You’s Cause and Effect through the heavenly secret.

What’s more, Mo Hua can sense that his own "Cause and Effect" is instead being spied upon by the Hua family.

This is a more advanced form of "espionage".

Due to its carefulness and avoiding touching his "past", it can instead exert a strong threat on the present self.

Over these two years of struggling with the Hua family, Mo Hua could already feel that the crises around him had increased tenfold compared to before.

These crises could come from Cause and Effect, Demon Monsters, Evil Spirits, or possibly from certain turncoat individuals, fallen desires, and insidious hearts...

And Mo Hua is well aware, although his Divine Sense is very strong now, nearly invincible in the Divine Way, his Divinity is pure to the point of nearing deity, his physical body is ultimately just a Foundation Establishment skin, incapable of withstanding any close-range "machinations".

Therefore, as the "Divine Blessing" Mo Hua, during this time when deeply targeted by the Hua family’s hatred, he is more cautious than ever before.

Unless with a person he truly trusts, he never dares to let anyone close.

And wherever he goes, he always travels with the Big Tiger, ensuring that the Big Tiger of the third-grade golden core realm is always nearby as his close guard.

...

Now, nightfall.

In a Divine Blessing hall somewhere in the Mountain Realm.

The lights are bright, resplendent with gold and jade.

Mo Hua sits in a high position, still focused on calculating the fortunes and directions of the conflict with the Hua family.

The black-patterned, white-furred Big Tiger lies next to Mo Hua, its head resting on the ground, dozing with its eyes drooping.

Its furry body resembles both a city wall and a large pile of blankets, wrapping Mo Hua in the middle.

Moments later, in the night, the dozing Big Tiger slowly opens its eyes and looks towards the hall’s doorway.

After a while, a person bows at the entrance and walks inside, stooped with a thick stack of files and jade slips in hand.

It is Iron Skill Bone.

"Divine Priest, here are the current battle reports of various Mountain Realms, please take a look..."

"The tasks you instructed have also been completed for you..."

Mo Hua slightly nodded.

Receiving permission, Iron Skill Bone respectfully walked forward and presented the jade slips and files to Mo Hua.

Mo Hua silently watched Iron Skill Bone, after a while, he said:

"You’ve worked hard..."

Iron Skill Bone bowed and said:

"Being able to serve by Divine Priest’s side is an immense honor, Iron Skill Bone does not feel it’s hard work."

Mo Hua shook his head, "No..."

His gaze bore deep golden light, seemingly seeing through Iron Skill Bone, speaking indifferently:

"I mean... it’s hard for you as the tribe’s ’ancestor’ to still personally come to serve me..."

As soon as the words fell, Iron Skill Bone’s body shivered involuntarily.

He immediately looked up at Mo Hua, eyes already carrying a hint of astonished and somber ash-like hue.
